_comment: Alpha Vantage symbols. Free tier is 25 requests/day, so this list must stay under ~20 to
leave headroom for a retry. Each entry costs exactly ONE TIME_SERIES_DAILY call, which
returns ~100 trading days (compact) - enough for 1w/1m/3m relative strength without any
extra requests. Do NOT use GLOBAL_QUOTE: same request cost, only one day of data.

symbols.name: Gold (GLD ETF)
symbols.note: Replaces the deleted FRED series GOLDAMGBD228NLBM. GLD tracks spot gold less ~0.40%/yr expense drag; fine for direction and rate-of-change, not for an absolute spot price.

deferred.reason: FX needs the CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE / FX_DAILY endpoint, not TIME_SERIES_DAILY. Add once live keys confirm free-tier FX access, which Alpha Vantage has restricted before.
Needs DIGITAL_CURRENCY_DAILY. Deferred to keep Phase 1 within the 25/day cap with retry headroom.

budget.note: 14 of 25 used by the morning run; alert runs cost 1. The index and international tiles moved to Yahoo, which is unmetered, so this list now holds only what the regime engine itself needs: breadth (SPY/RSP), the eleven sectors, and gold.
